notes.ATG: 除罪化；拉斯塔法里教徒可以種、用
notes.AUS: 依州而定：首都特區可以個人使用（不准販賣），北領地與南澳除罪化，其他州違法
notes.AUT: 2016 年 1 月起個人持有除罪化
notes.BRB: 違法，但登記的拉斯塔法里教徒可以作宗教用途
notes.BEL: 持有 3 克以下或種 1 株除罪化
notes.BLZ: 持有 10 克以下除罪化
notes.BMU: 持有 7 克以下除罪化
notes.BRA: 持有 40 克以下或種 6 株自用除罪化
notes.COL: 持有 22 克以下或種 20 株自用除罪化
notes.CZE: 21 歲以上可以在公共場所持有 25 克、私人場所 100 克以下，自種 3 株
notes.DMA: 持有 28 克以下除罪化
notes.FRA: 違法，但通常以當場罰款代替起訴
notes.GEO: 2018 年憲法法院判決個人使用合法，但不准販賣；2025 年起法律只對初犯除罪化（乾燥 5 克、新鮮 10 克以下）
notes.DEU: 2024 年 4 月 1 日起可以持有、使用、自種，7 月 1 日起可以透過非營利的大麻俱樂部取得
notes.IND: 違法，但傳統的 bhang（大麻飲品）例外
notes.ITA: 持有除罪化；在家少量種植自用合法
notes.JAM: 持有 56.5 克以下或種 5 株除罪化；拉斯塔法里教徒合法
notes.PRK: 違法，但據脫北者說普遍不取締
notes.LUX: 在家可以種 4 株自用；在外面持有 3 克以下除罪化（罰款）；不准販賣
notes.MLT: 可以持有、使用、自種，透過非營利的大麻俱樂部取得
notes.MEX: 有許可就可以持有、使用、種，不准販賣
notes.NPL: 違法，但濕婆節（Maha Shivaratri）期間准許
notes.NLD: 持證的咖啡店可以賣、可以在店裡用（容許，不是合法）；持有 5 克以下除罪化
notes.PAK: 違法，但常不取締（尤其部分部落地區）
notes.PRY: 持有 10 克以下除罪化
notes.PER: 持有 8 克以下除罪化
notes.POL: 違法，少量可能不取締；THC 0.3% 以下合法
notes.PRT: 持有 25 克以下的大麻或 5 克以下的大麻脂除罪化
notes.KNA: 持有 56 克以下除罪化
notes.LCA: 持有 30 克以下除罪化
notes.VCT: 持有 56 克以下除罪化
notes.ZAF: 在私人場所可以持有、種、使用，不准販賣
notes.ESP: 除罪化：私人場所可以持有、使用、種，包括大麻社團；公共場所會被罰款
notes.CHE: 除罪化；THC 1% 以下的大麻合法
notes.SYR: 違法，內戰開始後普遍不取締
notes.TWN: 大麻是第二級毒品（毒品危害防制條例），施用、持有都有刑責
notes.THA: 違法，但常不取締：2022 年開放 20 歲以上娛樂使用，2025 年沒有處方、THC 0.2% 以上的產品又列為違法
notes.TTO: 持有 30 克以下、每個成人種 4 株除罪化
notes.GBR: 違法，單純持有可能只是警告或當場罰款，不起訴
notes.USA: 依州而定：24 州、3 個屬地與華盛頓特區合法，另 7 州除罪化；聯邦法律仍列第一級管制、違法
notes.URY: 合法，非居民不能買；可以自種 6 株，會員俱樂部最多 45 人

notesEn.ATG: Decriminalised; Rastafari may grow and use it
notesEn.AUS: Varies by state: legal for personal use in the ACT (not sale), decriminalised in the Northern Territory and South Australia, illegal elsewhere
notesEn.AUT: Possession for personal use decriminalised since January 2016
notesEn.BRB: Illegal, except spiritual use by registered Rastafarians
notesEn.BEL: Decriminalised up to 3 g or one plant
notesEn.BRA: Decriminalised up to 40 g or six plants for personal use
notesEn.COL: Decriminalised up to 22 g or 20 plants for personal use
notesEn.CZE: From age 21, up to 25 g in public and 100 g in private, and three plants for personal use
notesEn.FRA: Illegal, but on-the-spot fines are usually issued instead of prosecution
notesEn.GEO: Personal use legal under a 2018 Constitutional Court ruling, but not sale; since 2025 the law decriminalises only first offences (up to 5 g dried or 10 g fresh)
notesEn.DEU: Possession, use and home growing legal since 1 April 2024; non-profit cannabis clubs since 1 July 2024
notesEn.IND: Illegal, with an exception for bhang
notesEn.ITA: Possession decriminalised; small-scale home growing for personal use legal
notesEn.JAM: Decriminalised up to 56.5 g or five plants; legal for Rastafari
notesEn.PRK: Illegal, but widely unenforced according to defectors
notesEn.LUX: Up to four plants at home for personal use; up to 3 g outside the home decriminalised (fine); sale prohibited
notesEn.MLT: Possession, use and home growing legal; supply through non-profit cannabis clubs
notesEn.MEX: Possession, use and cultivation legal with a permit, but not sale
notesEn.NPL: Illegal, but allowed during Maha Shivaratri
notesEn.NLD: Sale and use tolerated in licensed coffeeshops (tolerated rather than legal); up to 5 g decriminalised
notesEn.PAK: Illegal, but often unenforced (particularly in some tribal regions)
notesEn.POL: Illegal, but small amounts may not be prosecuted; below 0.3% THC legal
notesEn.PRT: Decriminalised up to 25 g of herb or 5 g of hashish
notesEn.ZAF: Possession, cultivation and use in private legal, but not sale
notesEn.ESP: Decriminalised: possession, use and cultivation allowed in private, including cannabis social clubs; fines in public
notesEn.SYR: Illegal, widely unenforced since the civil war began
notesEn.TWN: Cannabis is a Schedule 2 narcotic under the Narcotics Hazard Prevention Act; use and possession are criminal offences
notesEn.THA: Illegal but often unenforced: recreational use was legalised in 2022 for those 20 and over, and unprescribed products over 0.2% THC were recriminalised in 2025
notesEn.TTO: Decriminalised up to 30 g and four plants per adult
notesEn.GBR: Illegal, but simple possession may get a warning or on-the-spot fine instead of prosecution
notesEn.USA: Varies by state: legal in 24 states, 3 territories and DC, decriminalised in 7 more; illegal federally (Schedule I)
notesEn.URY: Legal, but non-residents may not buy; up to six plants; cannabis clubs of up to 45 members
